title: Deuxième partie : variations sur l'équation des lacets [suite à La "Longue Marche" à travers la théorie de Galois…, pages 293 à 650, dont table des matières] : notes et copies de notes manuscrites (s.d.).

errors: Possible sign slip. With ε_0^{-1}ρ = −λ'_0 σ and Tr ησ = Tr σ, one gets Tr(η ε_0^{-1} ρ) − Tr ρ = −λ'_0 Tr σ − Tr ρ = −(Tr ρ + λ'_0 Tr σ) = −λ'_0 c. The page writes λ'_0 Tr σ − Tr ρ, and the next page claims c' = λ'_0 c. These agree only up to sign conventions or the sign of c', which does not affect the invertibility conclusion.
The next-page transcription says N_1^2 = 1 ('carré unité'). The identity ε_1(λ) = 1 + N_1 λ = (1+N_1)^λ requires N_1^2 = 0 (square zero), so it should read 'carré nul'.

ideas.what: Elimination of η and μ: the solution set of a system for (ξ, η, μ) is identified with the locus in SL(M) defined by det ξ = 1, Tr ξρ = Tr ρ, P(ξ) invertible, with μ = c/P(ξ) forced to be a unit
ideas.modern_name: explicit parametrisation of a solution scheme / character-variety type locus in SL_2

ideas.what: Symmetry ξ ↔ η of the hypotheses (λ'_0 = 1/λ_0, c' = λ'_0 c)
ideas.modern_name: symmetry of the solution set under exchange of generators

deep.surprise_reason: This is routine linear-algebra elimination inside an explicit rank-2 computation for the loop equation. It is interesting only as part of the larger unpublished 'variations sur l'équation des lacets' project, with no standalone new result on this page.
transcription_corrections: Previous/next page: 'N_1 une matrice de carré unité, N_1^2 = 1' should almost certainly read 'de carré nul, N_1^2 = 0'.
The crossed-out symbol before c' at the bottom of the page is illegible; '= c'' is the intended reading.
